name: Context7
description: Current library and framework documentation, fetched per question instead of recalled from training data.
note: Works without a key at a lower rate limit.

name: Exa
description: Neural web search built for agents: full page contents, not a list of links.

name: Brave Search
description: Independent web index. A second opinion when one search engine keeps returning the same three pages.
note: Reference server, last published 2024 — check it still runs.

name: Notion
description: Read and write Notion pages and databases.
note: Create an internal integration, then share the pages with it — an unshared page is invisible to the token.

name: Obsidian
description: Search and edit an Obsidian vault.
note: Needs the Local REST API community plugin running inside Obsidian.

name: Memory
description: A knowledge graph the agent writes to and reads back across runs.

name: Engram
description: Your own memory service. Set its URL before enabling — the library does not guess where your services run.

name: Lineary
description: 48Nauts ticket and issue tracking. Set its URL before enabling.

name: Linear
description: Issues, projects and cycles in Linear.
note: Authorization: Bearer <token>. The hosted endpoint answered 401 at seed time, meaning it is alive and wants auth.

name: Sentry
description: Errors and traces from Sentry, including the issue an agent is asked to fix.

name: Gmail
description: Read, search, draft and send mail.
note: Needs gcp-oauth.keys.json in ~/.gmail-mcp before it will start — a Google Cloud OAuth client, not just a key. Verified 2026-08-15: without it the server exits immediately.

name: Google Calendar
description: Read and create calendar events.
note: Path to the OAuth client JSON downloaded from Google Cloud.

name: Slack
description: Read channels and post messages as a bot user.
note: Reference server, last published 2025 — check it still runs.

name: GitHub
description: Issues, pull requests and code search on GitHub. Development here lives on Forgejo, so this is for mirrors and other people's repositories.
note: Authorization: Bearer <personal access token>.

name: Playwright
description: Drives a real browser: open a page, click, fill, screenshot, read the console.

name: Filesystem
description: Read and write files under paths you name — and only those.
note: Add each allowed directory as an argument. With no path it exposes nothing.

name: Postgres
description: Read-only SQL against a Postgres database.
note: Add the connection string as an ARGUMENT (it exits with 'Please provide a database URL' otherwise). Reference server, last published 2024.

name: Sequential Thinking
description: A scratchpad for multi-step reasoning the model can revise as it goes.

name: Figma
description: Reads Figma files so a build can follow the actual design rather than a screenshot of it.

name: Excalidraw
description: Diagrams as data. Runs locally on port 3001.
note: Start the local Excalidraw MCP server first; nothing here launches it.

name: Forgejo
description: Issues and pull requests on the Forgejo host where development actually lives. GitHub is only a mirror here.
note: Forgejo speaks the Gitea API, so the client is gitea-mcp. The npm package forgejo-mcp ships no executable — npx cannot run it, which verification catches. Token: the one in ~/.config/forgejo/token.

name: Codebase Memory
description: The code knowledge graph: who calls what, trace a path, find dead code, impact of a change.

name: NautDocs
description: Search the vault, the knowledge base, tickets and memories in one place.

name: Kubernetes
description: Inspect and operate a cluster through your existing kubeconfig.
note: Uses the current kubectl context. Point it at the right cluster before enabling.

name: Supabase
description: Query and manage a Supabase project: tables, migrations, edge functions.

name: 21st.dev Magic
description: Generates React UI components from a description, in the style of 21st.dev.

name: Firecrawl
description: Scrapes and crawls sites into clean markdown, including pages that need JavaScript.

name: Tavily
description: Search and extract, tuned for agents rather than humans.

name: Todoist
description: Tasks, projects and due dates in Todoist.

name: Jira & Confluence
description: Atlassian's own hosted server: Jira issues and Confluence pages.
note: OAuth. The hosted endpoint answered 401 at seed time, meaning it is alive and wants auth.

name: Google Drive
description: Search Drive and read documents.
note: Needs a Google OAuth client file, like Gmail. Reference server, last published 2025; it exits at once without one.

name: Airtable
description: Read and write Airtable bases as structured records.

name: Stripe
description: Payments, customers and subscriptions. Read-only until you give it a key that can do more.
note: Authorization: Bearer <restricted key>. Use a RESTRICTED key, never the live secret.

name: Time
description: Current time and timezone conversion, so an agent stops guessing what 'today' is.

name: Adobe Creative Cloud
description: Edit images and run Adobe creative workflows: background removal, vectorization, retouching.

name: Aikido Security
description: Scan code for SAST findings, secrets and IaC vulnerabilities with Aikido.
note: Needs an Aikido account; the CLI prompts for login.

name: Airwallex
description: Payments, payouts, FX and account data through Airwallex AgentOS.

name: Airwallex Developer (sandbox)
description: Airwallex sandbox developer server for API exploration and test transactions.
note: Sandbox endpoint, not production.

name: Aiven
description: Provision and manage Aiven-hosted PostgreSQL, Kafka, OpenSearch and ClickHouse services.

name: Amplitude
description: Query Amplitude product analytics: events, charts and cohorts.

name: Apollo.io
description: Prospect search, contact and company enrichment, lists, sequences and one-off emails.
note: Also published in the Cursor registry as apollo-io.

name: Apollo GraphOS
description: Apollo GraphOS tools for schema design, federation and query work.

name: Appwrite
description: Manage Appwrite projects: databases, users, functions and storage.
note: Needs an Appwrite endpoint, project id and API key.

name: Asana
description: Create and manage Asana tasks, search projects, update assignments and track progress.
note: URL is documented in the plugin, not a manifest; run /asana-setup to register your own OAuth app first.

name: Ashby
description: Search candidates and jobs, prep for interviews and manage recruiting pipeline tasks.

name: Atlan
description: Search the Atlan data catalog for assets, lineage and glossary terms.

name: AWS Knowledge
description: Search AWS documentation, API references and regional availability.
note: Shared by several AWS toolkit plugins (startup-advisor, databases-on-aws, migration-to-aws).

name: AWS DevSecOps Agent
description: AWS DevOps agent endpoint for pipeline, security and remediation tasks.
note: Requires a bearer token; region defaults to us-east-1.

name: AWS API Proxy
description: Proxy to the AWS MCP endpoint covering core AWS service APIs.
note: One package (mcp-proxy-for-aws) also backs the Amplify, data-analytics, SageMaker and Location plugins.

name: AWS Serverless
description: Build and deploy AWS serverless applications: Lambda, SAM and API Gateway.
note: Runs with --allow-write.

name: AWS Transform
description: Run AWS Transform modernization jobs for .NET, mainframe and VMware workloads.

name: Azure
description: Manage Azure resources: subscriptions, storage, Cosmos DB, AKS and Monitor.
note: Uses the local Azure CLI credentials.

name: Bigdata.com
description: Search Bigdata.com financial and market research content.

name: Browser Use
description: Drive a real browser from the agent: navigate, click, fill and extract page content.
note: Needs Python 3.12.

name: Canva
description: Create and edit Canva designs, apply brand checks and resize for social.

name: Zoho Catalyst
description: Deploy and manage Zoho Catalyst serverless functions and data stores.
note: URL is the US data centre; other regions use a different host.

name: Chrome DevTools
description: Inspect and control Chrome: DOM, network, console, performance traces and screenshots.

name: Circle
description: Circle codegen server for USDC and programmable wallet integration code.

name: Circleback
description: Search meetings, transcripts, action items, calendar events and emails.

name: Clay
description: Find and enrich people and companies, run research agents and trigger Clay workflows.

name: ClickHouse Cloud
description: Query and manage ClickHouse Cloud services and databases.

name: Cloudflare
description: Manage Cloudflare zones, Workers, DNS and settings.
note: The plugin also ships docs, bindings and builds servers on separate URLs.

name: Cloudinary
description: Manage Cloudinary assets, transformations and structured metadata.
note: The plugin also exposes env-config, metadata and analysis servers on separate URLs.

name: CodSpeed
description: Read CodSpeed performance benchmark runs and regressions.

name: Confidence
description: Manage Confidence feature flags and experiments.
note: A second URL serves Confidence docs.

name: Convex
description: Inspect and mutate Convex deployments: tables, functions and data.
note: Runs against the Convex project in the working directory.

name: Google Data Agent Kit
description: Google Cloud data toolbox server for Dataproc, notebooks and visualization.

name: Datadog
description: Query Datadog metrics, logs, traces, monitors and incidents.
note: DD_MCP_DOMAIN must be set to your Datadog site host, plus API and application keys.

name: AWS IaC
description: Generate and apply AWS infrastructure-as-code (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).

name: Desktop Commander
description: Local file editing, terminal commands and process control on the host machine.
note: Broad local filesystem and shell access.

name: Docusign
description: Work with eSignature envelopes and templates, Maestro workflows and Navigator agreements.
note: Beta; needs a Docusign integration key and secret.

name: Dropbox
description: Search, read and manage Dropbox files and folders.

name: Expo
description: Query Expo/EAS projects, builds, updates and submissions.

name: Firebase
description: Manage Firebase projects: Firestore, Auth, Storage, Hosting and Functions.
note: Uses the local Firebase CLI login.

name: Atlassian Forge
description: Build and deploy Atlassian Forge apps.
note: A second URL serves the Atlassian design system server.

name: Fullstory
description: Query Fullstory session and behavioural analytics data.

name: GitKraken
description: Git and issue-tracker operations across GitHub, GitLab, Jira and Azure DevOps.
note: Requires a GitKraken account login.

name: GitLab
description: GitLab projects, issues, merge requests and pipelines via the hosted API server.
note: OAuth on first connection; self-managed instances use a different host.

name: Gong
description: Account summaries, deal insights and call briefs from Gong.
note: Needs a Gong OAuth client id and secret.

name: Grafana Cloud
description: Query Grafana Cloud dashboards, datasources, alerts and incidents.

name: Grafana (self-hosted)
description: Query a self-hosted Grafana: dashboards, datasources, alerts and Loki/Prometheus data.
note: Needs Docker plus a Grafana URL and service-account token.

name: Greptile
description: Natural-language search and Q&A over indexed codebases.
note: Needs a Greptile API key.

name: Honeycomb
description: Query Honeycomb observability data: events, traces and SLOs.

name: Hostinger
description: Manage Hostinger VPS, domains, DNS, hosting and mail.
note: Needs a Hostinger API token.

name: HubSpot
description: Search and update contacts, companies, deals and tickets; work with conversations and marketing email.
note: Needs a HubSpot OAuth client id and secret.

name: Hugging Face
description: Search Hugging Face models, datasets, Spaces and papers.
note: Anonymous access is limited; login raises quotas.

name: Hunter
description: Find and verify professional email addresses and enrich company data.

name: Intercom
description: Search Intercom conversations and contacts, look up companies and manage Help Center articles.

name: JFrog
description: Query JFrog Artifactory and Xray for artifacts, builds and vulnerabilities.
note: JFROG_URL must point at your JFrog platform instance.

name: LegalZoom
description: Request LegalZoom attorney consultations and legal service workflows.

name: Pydantic Logfire
description: Query Logfire traces, logs and metrics.
note: Defaults to the US region; EU accounts override LOGFIRE_MCP_URL.

name: LogRocket
description: Query LogRocket session replays, errors and frontend performance data.

name: Lovable
description: Manage Lovable projects and generated app deployments.

name: Lusha
description: B2B contact and company data lookup and enrichment.

name: Mapbox
description: Geocoding, directions, isochrones and map style tooling.
note: The plugin also ships devkit and docs servers on separate URLs.

name: Mercado Pago
description: Mercado Pago payments, preferences and merchant API operations.

name: Microsoft Learn
description: Search Microsoft Learn documentation for Azure, .NET and Microsoft 365.

name: Mintlify
description: Search documentation sites hosted on Mintlify.

name: Miro
description: Read and create Miro boards, frames and sticky notes.

name: monday.com
description: Read and update monday.com boards, items, columns and updates.

name: MongoDB (local)
description: Connect to a MongoDB deployment: query collections, inspect schemas and run aggregations.
note: Needs a connection string in the environment or arguments.

name: MongoDB Atlas
description: Manage Atlas clusters, database users, network access and backups.
note: OAuth on first connection.

name: Navan
description: Query expenses, travel bookings, policies, approvals and cards.

name: Neon
description: Manage Neon Postgres projects, branches and databases; run SQL.

name: Netlify
description: Create and manage Netlify sites, deploys, env vars and functions.
note: OAuth on first connection.

name: New Relic
description: Query New Relic entities, NRQL, alerts and APM data.

name: Nimble
description: Web search, page scraping and structured web-data extraction.

name: PagerDuty
description: Read and act on PagerDuty incidents, services, schedules and on-call rotations.
note: Needs a PagerDuty API key.

name: PayPal (sandbox)
description: PayPal sandbox server for orders, invoices, subscriptions and disputes.
note: Sandbox only; needs a sandbox access token.

name: Pigment
description: Query Pigment business planning models and metrics.
note: The URL contains a per-workspace MCP id you must substitute.

name: Pinecone
description: Manage Pinecone indexes and run vector search.
note: Needs a Pinecone API key.

name: PlanetScale
description: Manage PlanetScale databases, branches and deploy requests; run queries.

name: PostHog
description: Query PostHog product analytics, feature flags, session replays and insights.

name: Postman
description: Work with Postman collections, environments, mocks and API specs.
note: POSTMAN_MCP_MODE selects the full or minimal toolset.

name: Prisma
description: Manage Prisma schemas, migrations and Prisma Postgres databases.
note: A hosted Prisma server is also available at mcp.prisma.io.

name: Profound
description: Retrieve AI visibility, sentiment and citation reports; run Profound agents.

name: Qt Docs
description: Search Qt framework documentation and API references.

name: Railway
description: Manage Railway projects, services, deployments and variables.

name: Render
description: Manage Render services, deploys, logs and environment groups.
note: OAuth on first connection.

name: Resend
description: Send transactional email and manage Resend domains, audiences and broadcasts.

name: RevenueCat
description: Read and configure RevenueCat projects, products, entitlements and subscriber data.

name: Rill Developer
description: Query Rill dashboards and metrics from a local Rill Developer instance.
note: Points at http://localhost:9009; Rill must be running locally.

name: Rootly
description: Manage Rootly incidents, alerts, on-call schedules and retrospectives.

name: Salesforce
description: Query, search, create, update and traverse Salesforce records.
note: Production URL shown; sandboxes use .../v1/sandbox/platform/... Needs an External Client App consumer key.

name: Sanity
description: Query and mutate Sanity content datasets and schemas.

name: SAP CAP (CDS)
description: Work with SAP Cloud Application Programming models: CDS schemas, services and builds.

name: SAP Fiori Tools
description: Generate and modify SAP Fiori elements applications.

name: SAP HANA CLI
description: Inspect and query SAP HANA schemas, tables and procedures.
note: Needs HANA connection details in the environment.

name: SAP MDK
description: Build SAP Mobile Development Kit applications and metadata.

name: Serena
description: Semantic code retrieval and editing toolkit driven by language servers.
note: Installed from git, so uvx resolves it at run time rather than from PyPI.

name: Shippo
description: Create shipping labels, compare carrier rates and track parcels.

name: Sonatype
description: Check open-source dependencies for vulnerabilities and policy violations.
note: Needs a Sonatype token.

name: Sourcegraph
description: Code search and navigation across your Sourcegraph instance.
note: Needs your instance URL and an access token.

name: SumUp
description: SumUp merchant, transaction and payout API access.

name: Synthflow
description: Build and manage Synthflow AI voice agents and call workflows.
note: A second URL serves Synthflow docs.

name: Terraform
description: Look up Terraform providers, modules and registry docs; query Terraform Cloud.
note: Needs Docker; TFE_TOKEN only for Terraform Cloud access.

name: Twilio Docs
description: Search Twilio and SendGrid developer documentation.

name: SAP UI5
description: Build and lint SAP UI5 applications; look up UI5 API documentation.

name: Val Town
description: Create, run and deploy Val Town serverless functions and HTTP endpoints.

name: Vanta
description: Query Vanta compliance controls, tests, evidence and vendor risk.
note: Regional variants exist for the EU and Australia.

name: Vercel
description: Search Vercel docs, list projects and deployments, inspect logs.
note: Read-only; OAuth on first connection.

name: Windsor.ai
description: Query marketing data: ad spend, campaigns and analytics from connected sources.

name: Wix
description: Manage Wix sites, apps, headless projects and design system components.

name: X
description: Search posts and users, read timelines and mentions, manage lists, bookmarks and mutes.

name: Zapier
description: Run Zapier actions across connected apps from a single endpoint.
note: Needs a per-user Zapier MCP endpoint configured in your Zapier account.

name: Zoom
description: Search Zoom meetings and recordings, pull summaries and transcripts, work with Zoom Docs.
note: Needs a Zoom access token; the Cursor registry ships an OAuth variant.

name: ZoomInfo
description: B2B company and contact intelligence lookup and enrichment.

name: Zscaler
description: Query and configure Zscaler ZIA, ZPA and ZDX policies and reporting.
note: Credentials must be supplied as environment variables.
